atq.text: The Golgothian Sylex is accidentally netted by Yumok fishermen in 36 AR, and they send it to Feldon, who with Loran feels darkness on touching it.
During the Fall of Terisia City, Loran flees with the Sylex but is caught in an avalanche triggered by Ashnod, who wounds, captures and relieves her of it.
At the Battle at Argoth, Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos, who conveys it and its detonation process to Urza, and in remorse Urza performs its ritual with his blood, grief and pain.

Urza unleashes it, slaughtering both armies and sinking Argoth, which ends the Brothers' War and sends Dominaria into an Ice Age, and much later Jared uses the Rust Daggers to destroy the Sylex with Shatter.
